audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is given to Dr. Mundo at 7/10 while its own why says Garen's Q silence and spin out-trade him there; Level 6 is given to Dr. Mundo while the level-6 spike and mid text both say Demacian Justice is the worst possible ult for a health-stacker; 2+ items is given to Garen while its why and spikes[3] both say that is the one phase that flips to Dr. Mundo. whys[4] and whys[5] are also shifted one row out of phase.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo loses this lane at 48.59% over 3254 games and the packet chart gives Garen everything up to the final stage; the sides must match both the win rate and the prose already on the page.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Garen, Level 3 Garen, Levels 4-5 Garen, Level 6 Garen, First item Garen, 2+ items Dr. Mundo, with ratings and whys realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Demacian Justice is listed at 90s in two places; the real cooldown is 120/100/80. No other cooldown appears anywhere (the packet flags the total absence of sequencing advice).
audit.why: The whole page is built on 'track his ult', so the number has to be right — 120s at rank 1 is a much longer safe window than 90s, and at rank 3 it is 80s, shorter than your own Maximum Dosage at 120s.
audit.corrected: R written as 120s at rank 1 / 80s at rank 3, Decisive Strike as 8s, Courage as 22s at rank 1, Maximum Dosage as 120s.
sources: champ-data/_kits garen R cd 120/100/80, Q cd 8, W cd 22/19.5/17/14.5/12

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows affecting Garen, which deletes the Infected Bonesaw slow — the only tool Dr. Mundo has for holding him. Courage's shield and tenacity are never mentioned either, and Decisive Strike being an auto-attack reset is not flagged.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him' and 'activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity'. Mundo has no dash, so a slow-break plus a shield on the same combo is exactly why the chase never lands and why burst into his W is wasted.
audit.corrected: Q named as a slow-break, silence and auto-reset on 8s; W named as a shield plus tenacity on 22s at rank 1 that must be forced out before committing.

edits.before: Garen bullies the early game. His Q Decisive Strike silences you and lets him E Judgment spin on you while you can't kite with Q Infected Bonesaw. His passive regen negates your poke, so short-trading him just feeds his damage — farm and don't stand in the spin.
edits.after: Garen bullies the early game. Decisive Strike (Q) breaks every slow on him, silences you and returns every 8s, so your bonesaw never holds him for a walk-down. Courage (W) is a shield plus tenacity on 22s at rank 1 — force it out before you commit anything.

edits.before: At 6 his R Demacian Justice scales up as your health drops, the worst matchup for a health-stacker. Your R Maximum Dosage heal buys survival, but a fed Garen's Q-E-R can execute you outright, so never fight when you're low and always account for his ult before committing.
edits.after: At 6 his R Demacian Justice scales up as your health drops — the worst ult for a health-stacker — and it returns every 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3. Maximum Dosage buys survival on its own 120s, but a fed Garen's Q-E-R executes outright, so never fight low and count his ult first.

edits.before: - Garen Demacian Justice (90s): matchup-defining — True-damage execute scaling with your missing HP. Stay healthy. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Garen Demacian Justice (120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3): matchup-defining — a true-damage execute scaling with your missing HP. Stay healthy. - Decisive Strike (8s): breaks your bonesaw slow and silences you. - Your ultimate (120s): spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash.
